body.p:
Once you receive a translated XLIFF file, generate the translated version of your project:
Open the main DITA map in the DITA Maps Manager.
Right-click the map and select Translate (Fluenta) Import XLIFF .This action is visible only if there is a Fluenta project associated with the current DITA map and the XLIFF file will be imported for this project.
In the resulting dialog box, browse for the XLIFF file and set the options according to your needs:
Accept unapproved translations - Uses translations that are not marked as approved in the XLIFF file being imported.
Update "{MemoryName}" translation memory - Stores the imported translations in the project translations memory.
Ignore inline tag errors - If enabled, the application checks for mismatches in inline tags (such as <ph>, <bpt>, <ept>) between the source and target. This helps prevent formatting or structural issues in the translated content.
Click Import when finished.
Result: A translated version of the project content will be created in the indicated output folder. If your images are not in SVG format, you will have to copy them to the newly generated project.
